stories.title: ISP issues gas station safety reminder after car catches fire
stories.summary: ISP said a fire broke out after a driver tossed a lit cigarette butt on the ground while pumping gas. Officers said no one was hurt.

stories.title: First Alert Weather: Rainy conditions with winds expected to pick up Friday evening
stories.summary: The daily forecast from Idaho's trusted KTVB First Alert Weather team.

stories.title: Caldwell Police: Man arrested following felony domestic battery, felony injury to child
stories.summary: Armando Gallegos was arrested on multiple charges after fleeing from officers. One officer was injured during the arrest and was treated and released.

stories.title: Boise family's front yard Christmas tree finds new home at Grove Plaza
stories.summary: A 40-foot blue spruce that spent nearly 30 years growing in a Boise Bench family's front yard is now the city's holiday tree.

stories.title: Festival of Trees boosts healthcare support in Treasure Valley with holiday cheer
stories.summary: The Festival of Trees returns to Boise Centre, offering holiday cheer while raising funds for healthcare in the Treasure Valley.

stories.title: Idaho veteran and local business owner turn Veterans Day act of kindness into friendship
stories.summary: A free hauling offer from Krutch Hauling owner Dustin Herman helped Navy veteran Rickey Williams and sparked a friendship that has grown into family

stories.title: Suds Tavern receives 30-day alcohol suspension after third business violation in two-year period
stories.summary: A bartender at Suds Tavern was cited for allegedly serving alcohol to an intoxicated customer who later crashed into multiple objects, including the tavern itself.

stories.title: Angie Battle's secret Thanksgiving recipes you must try
stories.summary: Need a unique dish to bring to Thanksgiving this year? KTVB has you covered!

stories.title: Game Day Guide: Boise State returns to Colorado State for Pac-12 flex game
stories.summary: Boise State looks to bounce back after a loss to San Diego State damaged its playoff hopes, while Colorado State seeks a much-needed win in its season finale.

stories.title: Idaho gas prices down 87 cents from October as holiday travel begins
stories.summary: Nearly 476,000 Idahoans are expected to travel for Thanksgiving this year, and many will find lower gas prices than they have seen in months.

stories.title: Coroner identifies Boise man killed in I-84 crash
stories.summary: A 23-year-old man injured in a two-vehicle crash on I-84 earlier this month has died. The Boise man was identified Wednesday by the Ada County Coroner.

stories.title: Brabeion Academy founder Branden Durst separates from school. State also investigating alleged financial questions
stories.summary: The Idaho Public Charter School Commission is investigating financial irregularities at Brabeion Academy. The academy's founder has confirmed he's stepping away.
